CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Completed"), NOT(ISBLANK(Smart_Goal_in_Days__c )), Requires_Approval__c = FALSE), IF( Smart_Goal_in_Days__c <= 0, NULL, MIN( 1, MAX( 0.6, IF( BLANKVALUE(Business_Days_Since_Start_Date__c, 0) <= 0, 1, /* same-day or not started → 100% */ Smart_Goal_in_Days__c / Business_Days_Since_Start_Date__c ) ) ) )
,NULL)
CustomField.label: SLA Achievement
